prompt:
Bold modern typographic T-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

The saying is the hero and reads exactly "{spruch}" in large, striking, cleverly composed lettering that fills the design.
[[A small line below reads exactly "{sub}".]]
[[Add a small fitting icon matching "{icon}" as a graphic accent near the text, not as extra words.]]
[[Let the imagery and motifs nod to this theme (without adding extra words): {wunsch}.]]

The typographic arrangement follows the variation given below - a different layout every time. Strong statement-shirt look, high contrast, print-ready.

Style: clean bold statement typography, 2-3 strong colors plus cream, thick confident forms, no photorealism, no gradients.
